notes: Budget: 1 = any crew, 2 = some extra kit, 3 = specialist crew or rig, 4 = high-end (robot arm, VFX studio). kit: standard (any production house), specialist (specialist operator/rental; may need booking early or flying in), rare (few operators regionally; plan early). Local notes are general (home market Oman; Saudi drones need GACA permits); drones and public filming need permits in every GCC country; check every kit claim with the production house.

techniques.name: Dolly in / slow push
techniques.feeling: Growing focus or realisation; draws the viewer into a character's head.
techniques.how: Camera moves toward the subject on a dolly, slider or gimbal.
techniques.ai: partly: AI video can push in, but subtle parallax and focus breathing look synthetic

techniques.name: Dolly zoom (vertigo effect)
techniques.feeling: Shock, realisation, the world warping around someone.
techniques.how: Dolly toward the subject while zooming out (or the reverse) so the subject stays the same size and the background stretches.
techniques.gear: Zoom lens + dolly/slider, focus puller; or a motorised slider with lens control
techniques.ai: partly: possible in AI/VFX, hard to keep the subject stable

techniques.name: Tracking shot
techniques.feeling: Momentum, being with the character, a journey.
techniques.how: Camera moves alongside, behind or ahead of a moving subject.
techniques.gear: Gimbal, Steadicam, dolly track or car rig

techniques.name: One-take (oner)
techniques.feeling: Immersion and tension; the viewer can't look away.
techniques.how: A whole scene in one unbroken shot, or several stitched to look like one.
techniques.gear: Steadicam/gimbal, heavy rehearsal; hidden stitches in post
techniques.ai: no: choreography and real time are the point

techniques.name: Orbit / 360 around subject
techniques.feeling: Heroism, a moment of significance, the world revolving around someone.
techniques.how: Camera circles the subject on a circular track, gimbal or drone.

techniques.name: Crane / jib reveal
techniques.feeling: A reveal, scale, an ending.
techniques.how: Camera rises or descends on a crane, jib or telescopic arm.

techniques.name: Aerial / drone
techniques.feeling: Scale, freedom, epic landscapes, a place introduced.
techniques.how: Drone or helicopter footage.
techniques.gear: Drone (or helicopter for heavy cameras); licensed pilot
techniques.ai: yes for landscapes; AI aerials are close to real

techniques.name: FPV drone dive
techniques.feeling: Rush, speed, a single sweeping journey through spaces.
techniques.how: A small first-person-view drone flown manually, often through gaps and interiors.

techniques.name: Handheld
techniques.feeling: Realness, urgency, intimacy, documentary truth.
techniques.how: Operator holds the camera; movement is kept or exaggerated.
techniques.ai: partly: AI handheld often feels floaty

techniques.name: Snorricam (body-mounted)
techniques.feeling: Disorientation, intoxication, the world moving around a fixed face.
techniques.how: Camera rigged to the actor's body, facing them.

techniques.name: Whip pan
techniques.feeling: Energy, comedy, a fast hidden transition.
techniques.how: A pan so fast the image blurs, often used to cut between shots.

techniques.name: Robotic arm (bolt / motion control)
techniques.feeling: Precise, punchy, product-hero energy; impossible camera moves.
techniques.how: A programmable robot arm repeats or performs ultra-fast exact moves, often paired with high-speed cameras.
techniques.gear: Motion-control robot (e.g. Bolt) + operator, often a high-speed camera
techniques.ai: partly: AI can fake simple moves; exact repeatable passes need the rig

techniques.name: Parallax slide
techniques.feeling: Depth and texture; a calm premium feel.
techniques.how: Short lateral camera move with foreground and background layers moving at different speeds.

techniques.name: Static frame (locked-off)
techniques.feeling: Stillness, observation, patience; lets the people and light do the moving.
techniques.how: Camera on a tripod, no movement; the composition carries the shot.

techniques.name: Locked-on / object mount
techniques.feeling: The world spins while the subject stays still; dynamic product or vehicle energy.
techniques.how: Camera fixed to the moving object (car, bottle, bike).

techniques.name: Shallow focus (bokeh)
techniques.feeling: Intimacy, isolation, a premium portrait feel.
techniques.how: Wide aperture or long lens so only a thin slice is sharp.
techniques.gear: Fast lenses (f/1.4 to f/2), focus puller

techniques.name: Rack focus
techniques.feeling: Shifts attention; links two things in one shot.
techniques.how: Focus moves from one plane to another during the shot.

techniques.name: Split diopter
techniques.feeling: Tension between two people or things; uncanny clarity.
techniques.how: A half-lens makes near and far both sharp, with a soft seam.

techniques.name: Anamorphic widescreen
techniques.feeling: Big-screen cinema; epic or nostalgic feel; horizontal flares.
techniques.how: Anamorphic lenses squeeze a wide image; they give oval bokeh and streak flares.
techniques.ai: partly: AI imitates the flares, not the optics

techniques.name: Macro / extreme close-up
techniques.feeling: Sensory detail; makes small things epic (coffee, fabric, skin, food).
techniques.how: Macro lenses or probes very close to the subject.
techniques.gear: Macro lens or probe lens, strong light
techniques.ai: yes for stills; motion detail is harder

techniques.name: Probe lens
techniques.feeling: Tiny-world point of view; surprising, playful product journeys.
techniques.how: A long thin periscope lens goes inside objects and spaces.

techniques.name: Fisheye / ultra wide
techniques.feeling: Energy, comedy, youth and street culture; distortion.
techniques.how: Very wide or fisheye lens close to the subject.

techniques.name: Tilt-shift miniature
techniques.feeling: Toy-like, playful; real cities look like models.
techniques.how: Tilt lens (or blur in post) narrows focus, often with time-lapse.

techniques.name: Long lens compression
techniques.feeling: Compressed space: crowds packed, sun huge, heat shimmering.
techniques.how: Very long focal length from far away.

techniques.name: Slow motion (high frame rate)
techniques.feeling: Beauty, weight, a moment stretched; sensuality for food and liquids.
techniques.how: Shoot at a high frame rate (60 to 1000+ fps) and play back at normal speed.
techniques.gear: High-speed camera (to 240 fps standard; Phantom for 1000+), lots of light
techniques.ai: partly: AI slow motion of liquids is improving but physics often breaks

techniques.name: Speed ramp
techniques.feeling: Punch and rhythm; action emphasis; time slowing down at the key moment.
techniques.how: Playback speed changes within a shot, from normal to slow and back.

techniques.name: Time-lapse
techniques.feeling: Time passing; cities breathing; transformation; sky and light changes.
techniques.how: Frames shot at intervals and played back fast; hyperlapse adds camera travel.
techniques.gear: Camera + intervalometer, motion-control slider for moving lapses
techniques.ai: yes for skies; less for people

techniques.name: Bullet time / frozen moment
techniques.feeling: Time stops; the viewer walks around a frozen moment.
techniques.how: A camera array fires together; or actors freeze while the camera moves; or VFX.
techniques.gear: Camera array (rare) or performers holding still + gimbal; VFX
techniques.ai: partly: AI can freeze-and-orbit, details drift

techniques.name: Reverse motion
techniques.feeling: Magic, memory, undoing; surreal motion.
techniques.how: Shot played backwards, sometimes performed backwards for natural motion.

techniques.name: Stop motion
techniques.feeling: Handmade charm, playfulness, craft.
techniques.how: Objects moved frame by frame and photographed.
techniques.ai: partly: AI imitations look smooth, not handmade

techniques.name: Step-printing / stutter
techniques.feeling: Dreamy, druggy, memory-like motion smears.
techniques.how: Low shutter + repeated frames create a smeared stutter.
techniques.gear: Slow shutter in camera, frame doubling in post

techniques.name: Silhouette / backlight
techniques.feeling: Mystery, anonymity, iconic shapes, epic dusk.
techniques.how: Expose for a bright background so the subject goes dark.
techniques.gear: Natural backlight or strong back source

techniques.name: Golden hour / magic hour
techniques.feeling: Nostalgia, warmth, romance, hope.
techniques.how: Shoot in the low warm sun just after sunrise or before sunset.

techniques.name: Blue hour
techniques.feeling: Melancholy, calm, cities waking or sleeping.
techniques.how: Shoot in the cool twilight after sunset or before sunrise.

techniques.name: Chiaroscuro / low key
techniques.feeling: Drama, secrecy, power; painterly richness.
techniques.how: Strong single source, deep shadows, little fill.

techniques.name: Practical lights / neon
techniques.feeling: Atmosphere, nightlife, intimacy; colour from the location.
techniques.how: Light comes from sources visible in frame (lamps, neon, screens, car lights).

techniques.name: Haze / atmosphere
techniques.feeling: Mood, depth, sacred or mysterious light (god rays).
techniques.how: Haze machine, smoke or natural dust makes light beams visible.

techniques.name: Halation / film glow
techniques.feeling: Nostalgia, softness, warmth; an analogue feel.
techniques.how: Diffusion filters or film emulation make highlights glow red-orange.

techniques.name: Hard sunlight / high contrast
techniques.feeling: Heat, honesty, graphic shapes; Gulf summer.
techniques.how: Direct unsoftened sun or hard source; sharp shadows embraced.

techniques.name: Central framing / symmetry
techniques.feeling: Order, wit, control; a storybook or uncanny feel.
techniques.how: Subject dead centre, symmetrical sets, one-point perspective.

techniques.name: Wide shot, small figure (negative space)
techniques.feeling: Loneliness, awe, scale of nature versus a person.
techniques.how: Very wide framing with the person tiny in the frame.

techniques.name: Low angle / worm's eye
techniques.feeling: Power, heroism, monumentality.
techniques.how: Camera below the subject looking up.

techniques.name: Top-down / overhead
techniques.feeling: Pattern, design, a god's-eye view; food and table scenes.
techniques.how: Camera points straight down.

techniques.name: Dutch angle
techniques.feeling: Unease, madness, disorientation.
techniques.how: Camera rolled off level.

techniques.name: First-person POV
techniques.feeling: Empathy, immersion; the viewer becomes the character.
techniques.how: Camera sees what the character sees, often head-mounted.

techniques.name: Frame within a frame
techniques.feeling: Voyeurism, confinement, focus; an elegant composition.
techniques.how: Doors, windows, mirrors or arches frame the subject inside the shot.

techniques.name: Reflections
techniques.feeling: Duality, introspection, layered worlds.
techniques.how: Shooting via mirrors, water, glass or chrome.

techniques.name: Match cut
techniques.feeling: Wit and connection; jumps across time or place in one beat.
techniques.how: Cut between two shots that share a shape, movement or sound.

techniques.name: Seamless / hidden transitions
techniques.feeling: Flow, magic, one continuous journey through places.
techniques.how: Cuts hidden in whip pans, objects passing camera, or matching moves.
techniques.gear: Planned camera moves, edit, light VFX

techniques.name: Split screen
techniques.feeling: Comparison, simultaneity, rhythm.
techniques.how: Two or more images side by side.

techniques.name: Rhythmic montage / quick cuts
techniques.feeling: Energy, time compressed, youth and rhythm.
techniques.how: Short shots cut to music or sound design.

techniques.name: Freeze frame
techniques.feeling: Emphasis, humour, a character introduction.
techniques.how: A single frame held, often with titles.

techniques.name: Liquid splash / pour
techniques.feeling: Freshness, indulgence, appetite (drinks, coffee, food, cosmetics).
techniques.how: High-speed camera and rigs catch real splashes, or CG fluid simulation.
techniques.gear: High-speed camera, motion control, liquid rigs, tabletop crew; or CG simulation
techniques.ai: partly: AI liquids are close but breaking physics shows

techniques.name: Practical effects / in-camera
techniques.feeling: Tangible wonder; audiences feel it's real.
techniques.how: Effects done for real on set: forced perspective, rigs, sets, stunts.
techniques.ai: no: the point is that it's real
search_terms: in camera effects commercial forced perspective

techniques.name: Morph / transformation
techniques.feeling: Change and possibility; playful magic.
techniques.how: One object or person turns into another (VFX, or AI-assisted).
techniques.ai: yes: one of the things AI does well

techniques.name: Double exposure
techniques.feeling: Memory, inner world, poetic connection between person and place.
techniques.how: Two images layered, in camera or in post.

techniques.name: Projection mapping on people/places
techniques.feeling: Dreamlike, memory, culture painted onto bodies and buildings.
techniques.how: Images projected onto faces, walls or objects and filmed.

techniques.name: CG / live-action hybrid
techniques.feeling: The impossible made believable: giant products, fantasy worlds.
techniques.how: Computer graphics composited into filmed plates.
techniques.gear: VFX studio, plates shot for VFX
techniques.ai: partly: AI speeds concepting and some shots

techniques.name: Fake out-of-home (FOOH)
techniques.feeling: Social-first spectacle: products doing impossible things in real cities.
techniques.how: CG objects composited into real street footage, shared as if real.

techniques.name: 16mm / film look
techniques.feeling: Nostalgia, authenticity, warmth; memory.
techniques.how: Shoot on film, or emulate grain, halation and gate weave in the grade.
techniques.gear: Film camera + lab, or a grade

techniques.name: Black and white
techniques.feeling: Timelessness, memory, seriousness, graphic beauty.
techniques.how: Shot or graded in black and white.

techniques.name: Strong colour palette / colour blocking
techniques.feeling: Identity and mood carried by colour; ownable brand worlds.
techniques.how: Production design, wardrobe and grade restricted to a deliberate palette.

techniques.name: VHS / archival texture
techniques.feeling: Home-video nostalgia; family memory; Gulf 80s–90s.
techniques.how: Shoot on old camcorders or emulate in post.

techniques.name: Underwater
techniques.feeling: Weightlessness, dream, silence.
techniques.how: Camera in a housing; tank or open water.

techniques.name: Thermal / infrared
techniques.feeling: Surveillance, otherworldliness, heat made visible (useful for Gulf summer stories).
techniques.how: Thermal or infrared-converted cameras.

techniques.name: Cinemagraph
techniques.feeling: A frozen world with one living detail; elegant for digital and outdoor screens.
techniques.how: A still image with one looping moving element.

techniques.name: Light painting / long exposure
techniques.feeling: Energy, movement traced, the night made magical (traffic trails).
techniques.how: Long exposures record moving lights as trails.

techniques.name: Talking-head interview
techniques.feeling: Trust and testimony: a person telling their own truth.
techniques.how: Subject framed (often off-centre) speaking to an interviewer beside the camera; B-roll cut over it.
techniques.gear: Camera, lav/boom mic, soft key light
techniques.ai: no: real testimony is the point

techniques.name: Direct address (Interrotron)
techniques.feeling: Intimacy and confrontation: the subject looks straight at you.
techniques.how: The interviewer's face is projected over the lens (Errol Morris's Interrotron) or the subject is asked to look into the lens.

techniques.name: Observational / fly-on-the-wall
techniques.feeling: Being there: life unfolding without being explained.
techniques.how: A small crew films events as they happen, without interviews or narration, over long periods.
techniques.gear: Small camera, on-camera mic, long access

techniques.name: Archival footage / found footage
techniques.feeling: The weight of the past; history in its own images.
techniques.how: Existing footage (news, home video, film archives) licensed and edited into the story.
techniques.ai: partly: AI must never fake archive

techniques.name: Reenactment / dramatised reconstruction
techniques.feeling: Showing what no camera saw, openly staged.
techniques.how: Key moments restaged with actors or the real people, stylised so the audience knows it's reconstructed.
techniques.ai: partly: AI reconstructions must be labelled

techniques.name: Animated documentary
techniques.feeling: Protection and imagination: real voices, images that can show inner worlds or protect identities.
techniques.how: Real interviews or recordings set to animation.
techniques.ai: partly: AI can help animate, voices stay real

techniques.name: Self-documentation / diary film
techniques.feeling: First-person honesty: the maker's own life and voice.
techniques.how: The filmmaker or subject films themselves (phone, camcorder) and narrates in the first person.
techniques.gear: Phone or small camera, a mic

techniques.name: Essay film / voiceover
techniques.feeling: A mind thinking aloud over images; reflective, poetic.
techniques.how: Images (shot or found) cut to a personal written narration.
techniques.ai: partly: AI voices are a poor fit for a personal essay
